title: asphodelus albus var. sphaerocarpus
intro: Asphodelus albus var. sphaerocarpus, commonly known as White Asphodel, is a subspecies of the Asphodelus albus plant, belonging to the Asphodelaceae family. This perennial plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of White Asphodel are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which exhibit antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents also contribute to its potential use in traditional medicine, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
